title: leucanthemum monspeliense
intro: Leucanthemum monspeliense, commonly known as French Tansy, is a perennial plant that belongs to the sunflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of French Tansy include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of bloating and flatulence. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum monspeliense include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
